paths.description: Target root custom missing-page archetype and its primary recovery journey to Mobage home. No other same-host page archetype was discoverable: robots.txt and sitemap.xml repeat the same response. The broader sp.mbga.jp host is excluded except as the recovery destination.

findings.summary: Missing resources return HTTP 200 and lack indexing signals
findings.evidence: The root says the page does not exist while the document, /robots.txt, and /sitemap.xml all return HTTP 200 HTML; no canonical or robots directive exists.
findings.suggestedFix: Return a real 404 or 410 for missing resources. Serve valid robots.txt and sitemap.xml content, and add deliberate canonical/indexing directives where appropriate.

findings.summary: Core transport security headers are absent
findings.evidence: Headers evidence confirms HTTPS but no CSP, HSTS, or X-Content-Type-Options; cookies evidence finds no cookies.
findings.suggestedFix: Add an HSTS policy, a restrictive CSP appropriate to the inline footer script, and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff.

findings.summary: Browser defensive policies are not configured
findings.evidence: The response has neither frame-ancestors/X-Frame-Options nor Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Add frame-ancestors or X-Frame-Options, a strict Referrer-Policy, and a minimal Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: The error page has no semantic structure
findings.evidence: The DOM has no heading and no landmarks; Lighthouse fails landmark-one-main.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap the error content in main, use an h1 for the missing-page message, and mark the global links as nav with a label.

findings.evidence: The viewport sets maximum-scale=1.0 and user-scalable=no; Lighthouse flags this as an accessibility failure.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove maximum-scale and user-scalable restrictions so users can pinch zoom while retaining responsive layout.

findings.summary: The Japanese document does not declare its language
findings.evidence: The html element has no lang value and Lighthouse fails html-has-lang.
findings.suggestedFix: Set lang="ja" on html and keep direction inherited unless a localized variant requires dir="rtl".

findings.summary: The title and description do not describe the missing page
findings.evidence: The title is only モバゲー and no meta description is present.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a descriptive title such as ページが見つかりません | モバゲー and add a concise description where this response may be indexed or shared.

findings.summary: Robots and mobile-friendly signals are malformed
findings.evidence: The page disables zoom, and /robots.txt serves the same HTML error response; Lighthouse reports 58 robots.txt errors.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a valid text/plain robots.txt and remove viewport zoom restrictions. Keep the existing real href links and descriptive recovery text.

findings.summary: The page ignores the user dark-theme preference
findings.evidence: Dark-mode capture remains white with black text, and CSS inspection finds no color-scheme or prefers-color-scheme support.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and use system colors or light-dark() for page surfaces and text, while preserving the branded navigation contrast.

findings.summary: The primary recovery link has a short touch target
findings.evidence: The primary link box is 184.4 by 17px, while footer links are 60 by 48px and keyboard focus is visible.
findings.suggestedFix: Give the recovery link inline padding or an inline-block button treatment so its target is at least 24px high, ideally 44px on this mobile-first page.

findings.summary: A tiny error page waits on a render-blocking stylesheet
findings.evidence: HAR marks base.css parser-inserted at VeryHigh priority; Lighthouse estimates 730ms render-blocking savings, though LCP remains within the good range.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline the small critical styles for this error response or split/defer noncritical shared footer CSS while preserving cache reuse.
